data_layers_intro: Other data, drawn under the OSM features so that you can still edit what is on top.
data_layers_linked_error: The linked data could not be loaded: {reason}
data_layers_detail_file: From a file, not kept after a reload
data_layers_hint_geojson: An address of GeoJSON, or a file from your computer.
data_layers_hint_gpx: An address of a GPX track or route, or a GPX file from your computer.
data_layers_hint_pmtiles: The layer names are read from the file.
data_layers_hint_vector: The address has {z}, {x} and {y}. Name the source layers below.
data_layers_file_label: Or a GeoJSON or GPX file
data_layers_file_hint: A file is kept only until the page is reloaded. When a file is chosen, the address is not used.
data_layers_source_layers_hint: The names of the layers in the tiles, separated by commas.
data_layers_check_hint: An address is requested once, now, to check it. A layer is only requested while it is shown.
data_layers_error_kind: The kind must be one of {kinds}.
data_layers_error_object: A data layer must be an object.
data_layers_error_enter_address: Enter the address of the data.
data_layers_error_address_invalid: The address is not valid. It must start with https://.
data_layers_error_address_scheme: The address must start with https:// (or http://).
data_layers_error_address_template: A vector tile address needs {z}, {x} and {y} in it.
data_layers_error_source_layers_list: The source layers must be a list of names.
data_layers_error_need_source_layers: Vector tiles need the names of their source layers.
data_layers_error_id: The id must be 1 to 64 letters, digits, "-" or "_".
data_layers_error_name_empty: The name must not be empty.
data_layers_error_colour_hex: The colour must be a hex value such as #d6007a.
data_layers_error_only_vector_pmtiles: Source layers only apply to vector tiles and PMTiles.
data_layers_error_kml: KML is not supported. Use a GPX or GeoJSON file instead.
data_layers_error_not_json: This is not JSON, so it is not GeoJSON.
data_layers_error_not_geojson: This is JSON, but not GeoJSON. The top level must be a FeatureCollection or a Feature.
data_layers_error_not_gpx: This is not GPX: it must be XML with a gpx element at the top.
data_layers_error_gpx_conversion: This GPX file could not be converted.
data_layers_error_file_kind: A file can only be GeoJSON or GPX. Choose one of them, or give an address instead.
data_layers_error_vector_needs_layers: Vector tiles need the names of their source layers, separated by commas.
data_layers_error_link_not_file: A link names an address, not a file.
data_layers_pmtiles_no_layers: it lists no vector layers in its metadata.
data_layers_failure_data_unreachable: The data: the address could not be reached from this page. Check the address, and that the server allows requests from this site.
data_layers_failure_pmtiles_unreachable: Could not read this PMTiles file: the address could not be reached from this page. Check the address, and that the server allows requests from this site.
data_layers_failure_pmtiles_reason: Could not read this PMTiles file: {reason}
data_layers_failure_gpx_unreachable: Could not read this GPX file: the address could not be reached from this page. Check the address, and that the server allows requests from this site.
data_layers_failure_gpx_reason: Could not read this GPX file: {reason}
